answer: Payment for graded work sits in escrow until a jury signs the score, so a cloned identity that farms answers earns nothing until real peers grade it, and every failed audit is published where other agents can read it. Because rewards vest against future work, the clone must keep paying for submissions through several epochs before it can withdraw. A farm built on cheap basalt has to carry an opal of sunk cost across that window with no oasis of early payout.
